applies_to: draft PR #62 isolated Windows CI and prior recorder observations; not installed on Tapo PC

cases.scope: CI-only Windows2022 patched GLib/GIO; registry versus nochange, 0-16 epochs
cases.observed: Original #45015173260 private +221184B, optional REGION +155648B, heap BUSY -7794B; three independent GIO16 runs corroborated signs, not owners. Synthetic Windows2022 calibration #45040046000: controlled test HeapAlloc64/HeapFree48, 16 expected outstanding; ETW started before workload, sequential capture, logger zero-loss checked, xperf totals+size360 stack action PASS. This is NOT a recorded actual exact-16 xperf table count nor any real GIO owner. NEW 2026-11-23 synthetic ETW source-calibration Windows #45044677361 independently matched unique noinline source stack: 64 HeapAlloc(360) calls, 48 frees, 16 intentionally retained (=5,760 requested bytes); zero reported event/log buffer loss. Process-wide 360B size-filter saw ~78-85 total allocations, 16 outstanding; global Alloc KB/count semantics not identical. Proof is ONLY synthetic and NOT GIO leak attribution. 2026-11-23 actual disposable MSVC GIO runtime #45046446784: nochange watch registrations=6, APC completions=0, final pending=6/peak=6; registry 16cycles registrations=23, APC completions=17, final pending=6/peak=6; GIO SDK exports=2047 matched. This is direct *registry watch subscription* bounded-lifetime evidence, NOT overall GIO PrivateUsage leak classification.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: HeapWalk BUSY and REGION are different from PSAPI PrivateUsage; former only reports current blocks/selected regions. Prior ETW saved truncated top25 module frame occurrences, not matched allocation+free bytes or a complete call-site owner. Unproven worker quiescence biases endpoints. The corrected #45040046000 probe closes pre-workload event-start, circular overwrite, and missing local-symbol setup ONLY on a synthetic fixture. The filtered report has not yet been independently parsed into exact 16 outstanding / 5760 requested bytes and matching source stack, nor adapted to real GIO workload and global worker quiet boundary. Follow-up diagnosed that this WPT version's combined `-stacks -size 360 361` yielded no stack frames although unfiltered `-stacks -top 100` contained the synthetic symbol. `-totals -size ... -requireframes` did not isolate source count (e.g., 84 vs known64). Local parser now verifies unfiltered unique-source stack 64/16, so that synthetic gap is FIXED. No proof yet of true GIO owner across completed worker epochs. The watch subscription submechanism IS NOW bounded by both pinned source and runtime counts; previously only a source-level model had been available. It cannot explain the remaining owner-unknown GIO/WinRT and COM/heap commit residuals. Do not rerun watch bound as if unproven.
cases.missing_observable: Allocation IDs with matching frees and outstanding bytes grouped by sanitized module/source site on the same controlled lifetime boundary; commit movement by reserved/committed category, trace completeness and worker/APC idle provenance.
cases.next_automatic_action: Do NOT repeat watcher-source audit. Use proven pre-workload/per-cleanup probe signal fence (source preflight #45046783800) and validated no-loss sequential Xperf unfiltered *source stack* parser to run one isolated paired 16-cycle GIO ETW owner census (not top25 module frequency). Compare registry/nochange by source owner and annotate open worker/APC epochs; preserve max eight watch pending status blocks already runtime-proven. Require a distinct full alloc/free outstanding owner before considering a fix or bounded-commit classification. Host untouched.
cases.decisive_rule: Watch status-block cohort counts are already proved bounded in #45046446784 with 6 active in either arm; no evidence of per-rescan growth for this cohort. GIO16 overall residual stays evidence_gap until same-process owner-specific outstanding bytes, worker phase and committed region are reconciled. An APC in transit can invalidate a global idle claim, but not the direct watch-count invariant. Do not classify PrivateUsage as leak based on watcher counts.

cases.scope: Original uninstrumented four-arm 256-cycle Combo Windows2022 CI (not same as three GIO16 runs)
cases.observed: Combo settled control-adjusted PSAPI PrivateUsage +368640B; late192-256 +53248B. HeapWalk 360-byte size bin late controlled +5 blocks, size is not allocation owner.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: Original 256-cycle evidence saved aggregate endpoint counters, but no source-owned outstanding allocation lifetime or complete per-heap commit census. Instrumented 16-cycle and later UST traces are different processes/workloads; they cannot be backfilled as original allocation owners.
cases.missing_observable: Complete same-arm alloc/free ownership and committed/freeable region accounting at a proven quiet boundary for the specific late residual, preserving the original SDK and workload identity.
cases.next_automatic_action: First close GIO16_OWNER_AND_COMMIT's attribution and capture-completeness gate. Only then decide whether a differentiated short CI experiment can answer the original late residual; if not, predefine one minimal same-configuration window with a clear discriminating trace. Never rerun original four-arm 256 solely to repeat counters.
cases.decisive_rule: Classify only with same-workload lifetime evidence identifying an owned outstanding source or repeatable bounded retention; older 360B counts alone cannot settle either case.

cases.scope: CI-only Windows registry callbacks and GIO worker/APC parser cleanup
cases.observed: Archived phase trace reports worker_active_after_cleanup=1 and boundary_tick_ambiguous=1; 0-18 paired windows are not globally quiescent. Windows runtime #45046446784 shows APC delivery completed 17 times in registry 16-cycle arm, with 23 total re-registrations and 6 pending watches at the end. A pending watched key is normal: fully global APC queue idle NOT proven.
cases.why_previous_did_not_resolve: A finished AppInfo update counter does not acknowledge not-yet-delivered APCs or globally drain other async producers. Timed wait and GObject count alone can produce false leak/plateau conclusions. Even an observed per-key watch count bound is not a closed producer queue or worker quiescence acknowledgment. Watch counts quantify one source cohort only, and do not drain Windows APC or unrelated WinRT callbacks.
cases.missing_observable: Proven closed producer/consumer boundary, including callback arrivals, queued jobs, active worker count, update epoch completion and absence of delayed callback after snapshot.
cases.next_automatic_action: Use the CI-only pre-workload/pre-cleanup event fence to take reproducible before-cleanup allocation snapshots while recording APC watch transitions and existing AppInfo worker phase ordinals in the SAME run. Distinguish observed quiet/finished update epoch from unobservable future notifications; if no globally closed producer barrier exists, adopt scoped source-owned lifetime windows rather than inventing a global quiet state. AI CI only, no actual PC.
cases.decisive_rule: Counter zero is never sufficient. Any leak classification must name a verified allocation owner and expected lifetime, exclude active worker epochs, and transparently label outstanding notifications or future queue closure as unproven. Pending registry watches are bounded and expected at 6 in the specific Windows runner, not evidence of a leak.
